description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling PolicyEntryModified events within the Ditto policies persistence component. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides the applyEvent method to modify a PolicyBuilder based on the event data.

classes.name: PolicyEntryModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class designed to process PolicyEntryModified events and apply corresponding changes to a PolicyBuilder object.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle PolicyEntryModified events by updating the given PolicyBuilder with the event's policy entry.
